findings.trigger: Session commit succeeds, then inherited _restore fails HELD, packet, fresh capture, full-world or binding audit and returns null.

evidence.text: if not await _hold(b, "restored complete world"): return null

findings.impact: The caller already owns the installed Battle and identity. child battle receives null; finish explicitly disposes identity but does not queue_free the actual handed-off Battle. Session.dispose deliberately avoids freeing an installed world. Cleanup consequently depends on process exit and may cause native leak/error evidence; failure path is not statically closed.
findings.required_fix: Track the exact Battle object immediately after successful Session handoff/commit, before any fallible post-commit audit; only free that proven owned object once in finish. Never select arbitrary current_scene/menu or touch another task scene. Preserve old and v25b files and create a new c sibling plus independent review.

invocation_flag_review.limitations: Invocation flag records entry to the actual call, not successful native completion; row_completed and passed plus exit/log gate remain required.

hold_override_review.trailing_blank_line_difference: Child _hold is last function at EOF, while s has one extra separator blank line before its next method; all function body characters otherwise match. Do not call raw full extracted text byteexact for _hold.
hold_override_review.dispatch: Inherited _restore invokes _hold on self; child override plus inherited _on_held/_on_rejected is used. Child own run invokes restore/audits, never A/B/C/D gameplay drivers.

Session.handoff_world removes core identity ownership; installed Session.dispose does not release caller identity. Child explicit retained_identity.dispose occurs once behind finished guard. Post-commit failure Battle tracking remains the P2 above.

actual_source_capture_review.exactness: Complete encoded record/section wrappers and all fields compare after only independently bounded root wall msec and Mission stage_age_ms normalization. Codec stores f64/vector2 IEEE hex strings, so full record comparison includes numeric bits. _exact alone uses equality for direct Vector2 values; the post-undo full Codec world comparison supplies the independent IEEE check.
actual_source_capture_review.root_cache_node_order: Full simulation/clock_values, cached grid/group fields, recursive node object ID order, engine physics/process counters and logical tick are retained; no clearing caches or broad state reset.
